mstts:express-as.prosody:
Welcome to a journey where we’ll explore the thin line between our personal freedom and the pull of society around us.
Have you ever wondered where your right to express yourself ends, and the rules of the community begin? That’s exactly the kind of question we’ll be unpacking together.
Inspired by the thoughtful world of On Liberty by John Stuart Mill, we’re diving into what it really means to balance personal autonomy with the greater good.
Along the way, we’ll look at why standing up for individuality matters, how free speech and diverse opinions push us forward, and what risks come with letting the majority have too much power.
Mill doesn’t just defend our rights—he invites us to think deeply about what makes a society healthy, creative, and genuinely open to new ideas.
Together, we’ll see how protecting difference and encouraging honest debate aren’t just lofty ideals, but the heartbeat of a vibrant, just community.
So, let’s set out on this exploration—curious, open-minded, and ready to discover what liberty really means for each of us, and for all of us.
